name: Commuter Car · Round 1
domainSummary: A generic compact four-door commuter car with balanced hood, cabin, and rear volumes, short overhangs, a stable everyday wheelbase, and prominent wheel arches for recognition at small scale.
evidenceBoundary: Keep the car generic and unowned. Do not imply make, model, era, performance class, occupant, direction, or route.

researchSources.title: Career World ambient expansion inventory
researchSources.use: Accepted commuter-car role and canonical map-scale baseline.

researchSources.title: Tournament production ledger
researchSources.use: Canonical commuter-car geometry and identity boundary.

assets.name: Commuter Car · Canonical Production
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into its clearest production-ready map prop; emphasize four-door cabin volume
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested in its most resolved reusable form. This version emphasizes four-door cabin volume.

assets.name: Commuter Car · Silhouette Contrast
assets.controlledVariable: push the outer contour and negative spaces for instant recognition at map scale; emphasize short front and rear overhangs
assets.thesis: A distinct silhouette tests recognition without labels or color. This version emphasizes short front and rear overhangs.

assets.name: Commuter Car · Weighted Asymmetry
assets.controlledVariable: shift the dominant mass off-center while preserving the asset's practical balance; emphasize balanced hood cabin and rear masses
assets.thesis: Controlled asymmetry creates identity without sacrificing function. This version emphasizes balanced hood cabin and rear masses.
assets.businessCue: balanced hood cabin and rear masses

assets.name: Commuter Car · Functional Exposure
assets.controlledVariable: make the asset's defining working parts structurally legible without diagrams; emphasize visible wheel arches
assets.thesis: Exposed function tests whether the object reads through construction rather than decoration. This version emphasizes visible wheel arches.

assets.name: Commuter Car · Rugged Structure
assets.controlledVariable: strengthen load-bearing edges, joints, guards, and contact points; emphasize compact everyday road stance
assets.thesis: Rugged construction tests a durable working-world interpretation. This version emphasizes compact everyday road stance.

assets.name: Commuter Car · Modular Rhythm
assets.controlledVariable: organize repeated functional elements into a clear unequal rhythm on one coherent object or shared base; emphasize four-door cabin volume
assets.thesis: A modular cadence tests reuse and system belonging. This version emphasizes four-door cabin volume.

assets.name: Commuter Car · Low Profile
assets.controlledVariable: compress height and emphasize a long stable footprint while retaining every defining feature; emphasize short front and rear overhangs
assets.thesis: A low profile tests legibility in dense map placement. This version emphasizes short front and rear overhangs.

assets.name: Commuter Car · Vertical Accent
assets.controlledVariable: give one legitimate functional element a taller focal role while keeping the overall prop subordinate to buildings; emphasize balanced hood cabin and rear masses
assets.thesis: A vertical accent tests landmark readability without turning the prop into architecture. This version emphasizes balanced hood cabin and rear masses.
assets.businessCue: balanced hood cabin and rear masses

assets.name: Commuter Car · Compact Primitive
assets.controlledVariable: reduce the asset to the smallest complete form that preserves its exact identity and component count; emphasize visible wheel arches
assets.thesis: The primitive reveals which cues are essential. This version emphasizes visible wheel arches.

assets.name: Commuter Car · Ambient Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance silhouette, function, construction, modular detail, and map-scale restraint in one production-ready prop; emphasize compact everyday road stance
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests the complete ambient identity for repeated world use. This version emphasizes compact everyday road stance.
